Jordan / team,

Thanks for taking our SIG submission. We’ve flagged a few follow-ups around BCP/DR: specifically RTO/RPO evidence for the hosted API (region: us-west) and a short live walkthrough of your failover runbook. Our deadline to close this ticket with security is next Tuesday (2027-04-06).

Can you confirm: 1) a single zip with the runbook + a short statement of actual measured RTO/RPO from the last quarterly test, 2) a 30–45 minute walkthrough slot (we prefer mornings), and 3) any isolation/networking diagrams that indicate how warm-cache and KV state are recovered after failover?

We do not need full syslogs at this time, but an outline of the restore steps and who is expected to perform each step (engineer / SRE / automated) would be helpful. If you have a concise "jump kit" (1–2 pages) used for incident responders, that would be ideal.

Attaching the SIG question references below that map to the items we need.

Sally

Adding the operational detail requested. Short summary:

- Last tabletop + restore run (2027-03-18): cold-start restore of control plane + two API shards completed in 23 minutes median for service restore (RTO target is 30 mins, met). RPO measured at ~2 minutes for user-visible state (we exercise KV checkpointing + tailing replication). I attached the raw CSV with the run metrics.
- Jump kit: included a one-page "Responder Checklist" with explicit triage steps and escalation phone numbers. The checklist assumes an on-call SRE executes the recovery steps; automation reduces manual steps for cache warming and KV import.
- Network/isolation diagrams: see the Drive link Jordan included; those will show the cross-region routing and how traffic is drained and re-pointed to standby pools.

If Acme wants a brief demo of the automated restore (scripted restore + cache warm) during the walkthrough I can run it — should fit in the 30–45 minute window.

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks Jordan and Ben — that looks good. We’ll take Mon 2027-04-05 09:00–09:45 PT for the walkthrough (our side: Sally + Priya from infra + acme-security distribution). Could you: 1) upload the single ZIP to the Drive link you shared, 2) paste the short responder checklist in the meeting chat, and 3) include the CSV metrics in the packet?

A couple of quick clarifications from our reviewers: do you have a formal retention policy for incremental KV backups (we’re particularly interested in the 0–7 day window), and are there any manual recovery steps that require privileged access not covered by the jump kit? If so, note what roles are required and whether that process is covered by MFA/KMS access controls.

If you can drop the ZIP before the walkthrough we’ll mark the SIG item as pending review and aim to close it within 48 hours.

Sally
